_README: EDIT THIS FILE to tune all forecasting + planning numbers. No code changes needed. After editing, commit to GitHub; Render redeploys automatically. Sources noted per section.
_carbon_note: kg CO2e per vehicle-km, diesel, average-laden basis. Defaults derived from UK DEFRA/BEIS 2025 GHG conversion factors (articulated HGV ~0.89 kg/km; rigid >17t higher per km due to lower payload; ADT is off-highway plant, higher). Carbon is estimated as trips x round-trip distance x factor (loaded out, empty return).
_planning_note: Used to estimate haul-cycle turnaround, trips/day and fleet size for route planning. All editable.
